scope: Apply both six-way cross-fitted policies to all 185 registered cross-window training questions without additional model generation. On each target history use only parameters whose early rule-2 fit and four-path calibration excluded that history. Do not use the all-six deployment weights.
temporal_separation: Lock the hashes of both numerical main policy files, original protocol, fixed question assignments and the original cross-window manifest. Record every endpoint with any already published physical branch score when this joint lock is created. Report all measured cases, and separately the strictly later cases without any such branch. Do not label earlier data prospective. Reproduce native and both earlier pilot focal returns on the same observed state before comparing policies.
estimand: Expected F1 at the last annotated evidence span after a full prefix with the registered previous actions. Report paired gain against native, terminal, prefix-only, usage-matched and fixed alternatives. Report question types, history, evidence distance, prefix length, average propensity changes, hindsight budget limits and paired dialogue bootstrap after completion. This supplementary training study cannot itself authorize a test-set exposure.
